power.method: Solar / swappable internal battery / 12V DC / AC adapter

features: Quick-deploy radar-based license plate recognition (LPR) camera system
850 nm pulsed LED illumination for capture in total darkness
Capture range 30-75 ft (9.1-22.9 m), optimal 55 ft (16.8 m), 24 ft multi-lane field of view
Captures vehicle make, model and color; triggers at configurable speed thresholds up to 100 mph (161 km/h)
Bluetooth 5 LE, Wi-Fi 802.11ac and internal LTE modem
Tamper-resistant paintable shroud; integrates with VehicleManager Enterprise and Mobile Companion app
Dual-cell battery up to ~20,000 scans per charge; 45W solar panel option
